root_fallback_reason: The preferred OSSFS mount returned EIO errno 5 on the single directory creation attempt. All experiment state is kept under the /model fallback directory.
best_selection: strict test-fold ACC improvement; equal ACC retains the earlier epoch

data.patient_graph: inherit E74.4-G2 transductive graph without modification

base.initialization: independent E61 epoch-10 complete warmup for each fold and each group

architecture.prompt_encoder: frozen OpenAI CLIP RN50, original cached text features
architecture.semantic_basis: frozen E[8,8] from original deterministic CPU float64 thin SVD; verify E@E.T against original normalized Prompt Gram
architecture.semantic_center: fixed normalize(E[k] - mean(E,dim=0)); derived from original E and not trainable
architecture.global_features: AvgPool1d(4,4) over original four contiguous 36-value groups to [N,4,9]
architecture.g1_prompt_selection: node-conditioned: per patient and receiver evidence, no reduction over receiver slots before softmax
architecture.g2_prompt_selection: edge-conditioned: per patient, receiver, real candidate edge semantic score softmax over the four Prompts

shared_gradient_control.method: DARG-reference gradient: same-state original forward g_B, RNG-aligned enhanced forward g_F, delta_g=g_F-g_B
shared_gradient_control.conflict: remove delta_g component parallel to a conflicting g_B group vector
shared_gradient_control.reference_state_isolation: restore Python, NumPy, PyTorch CPU/CUDA RNG and all model/CAM buffers between reference and enhanced forward

optimization.public_rng: reference forward uses a restored RNG scope, enhanced forward consumes the single historical public forward stream

execution.scheduling: measure one actual worker peak on physical GPU1, then admit workers using physical GPU1 free memory and a safety reserve

metric_definitions.summary: mean plus population SD across folds, percent
